Name: dragonfire
Blurb: A forward cone of violet fire that leaves Fracture Burn.
Upgrades: ["Longer range","Wider cone","More damage to corrupted enemies","Eruption at the end of the breath"]

Name: wyrmwing
Blurb: Spectral wings: a launch, a controlled glide and one air dash.
Upgrades: ["Higher launch","Longer glide","Second air dash","Aerial strike on landing"]

Name: dragonhide
Blurb: Spectral scales: damage resistance and less stagger. Time it for a bonus.
Upgrades: ["More resistance","Less stagger","Wider perfect-timing window","Shares a smaller shield with nearby allies"]

Name: wyrmcall
Blurb: Vyrak answers: strafing runs, dragonfire on a group, interrupts, a finishing assault.
Upgrades: ["Longer stay","Shorter cooldown","Another strafing run","Finishing assault on bosses"]

Name: roar
Blurb: Vyrak bellows: nearby enemies are staggered and their next attack is delayed. Bosses only lose poise.
Upgrades: ["Wider roar","Longer stagger","Enemies take extra damage while staggered","Shockwave knocks smaller enemies back"]

Name: scalebreaker
Blurb: A tail-and-claw slam in front of you that shatters armor and hits boss poise hard.

Name: skyfall
Blurb: Vyrak climbs, then dives onto the target area in a violet impact. Needs room above and is a late-game finisher.
Upgrades: ["Larger impact","Shorter cooldown","Leaves Fracture Burn","Furious Vyrak hits harder"]
